title: 第五章 你太冒昧了第六章 他疯了吧
slug: 武道长生从大离第一纨绔开始

read2（）;“嗯……？”
看着顾尘风大摇大摆，带着欧阳财走出人群。
张邮满心狐疑。
据他的了解，如今的相国府，应该已经被掏空了，顾尘风哪来的四万两？
难道自己消息有误？
他当即吩咐身后几名随从。
“盯着他们，别让他们溜走了。”
……
与此同时，欧阳财满脸感动的看着顾尘风。
“三少，好兄弟一辈子，这钱算我借你的，过两日就还你。”
顾尘风瞥了他一眼。
“废话少说，先拿点钱来。”
“啊……？”欧阳财一脸懵逼。
“你不会以为本少爷，有钱帮你还债吧？”
欧阳财愕然道：“三少，那你刚才承诺的，一炷香内，连本带利……”
“当然是帮你赢回来，可斗兽总得有钱下注吧，我可没有带钱的习惯。”
“……”
欧阳财瞬间无语。
身为顾尘风的好基友，对方的斗兽水平，欧阳财清楚的很，根本是十赌九输的扑街。

“三少，要不我还是派人去家里取钱吧。
再说了，我身上的钱都输光了，没赌本了。”
“这……”
帝都双废，面面相觑。
顾尘风一扫周围人群，忽然眼前一亮，锁定了两道靓丽身影。
却说，瑶音公主方才心中发堵，便带着上官冰心，离开了广场，来到斗兽区闲逛。
期间，听到中央区域动静不小，二女好奇之下，过来围观。
不想，又遇到了顾尘风二人。
见顾尘风突然朝她们看来，瑶音公主轻哼一声，转身欲走。
“且慢！”
身后传来顾尘风的喊声。
瑶音公主头也不回。
却听顾尘风道：“上官小姐，请留步。”
“……”
瑶音公主脚步一僵。
上官冰心清冷秀丽的玉颜，浮起一丝讶色。
“顾公子，何事？”
“上官小姐，我想借点钱。”
“借钱？”
上官冰心一愣，这些年来，求问她姓名、年龄、家世……的男子，比比皆是。

来找她借钱的，这还是头一个。
以至于她都有些反应不及。
“上官姑娘，你身上有一万两银票吗？”
“没这么多。”上官冰心下意识回答。

read2(); "Huh...?"
Watching Gu Chenfeng swaggeringly leading Ouyang Cai out of the crowd.
Zhang You was full of suspicion.
According to his understanding, the Prime Minister's Mansion should have been emptied out now. Where did Gu Chenfeng get the 40,000 taels?
Could it be that my information is wrong?
He immediately ordered several followers behind him.
"Keep an eye on them and don't let them get away."
…
At the same time, Ouyang Cai looked at Gu Chenfeng with a moved face.
"Third Young Master, we are good brothers for life. This money is a loan from me and I will pay it back to you in two days."
Gu Chenfeng glanced at him.
"Stop talking nonsense and get some money first."
"Ah...?" Ouyang Cai was confused.
"You don't think that this young master has money to help you pay off your debts, do you?"
Ouyang Cai said in astonishment: "Third Young Master, what you promised just now is that within one stick of incense, you will get the principal and interest..."
"Of course I'll help you win it back, but you have to have money to bet on beasts. I'm not in the habit of bringing money."
"..."
Ouyang Cai was speechless for a moment.
As Gu Chenfeng's good friend, Ouyang Cai was very aware of his opponent's beast-fighting skills. He would lose nine out of ten bets.
“Third Young Master, why don’t I send someone to your house to get the money.
Besides, I have lost all my money and have no gambling capital. "
"This..."
The imperial capital was both in ruins, looking at each other in shock.
Gu Chenfeng swept through the crowd around him, and suddenly his eyes lit up, and he locked onto two beautiful figures.
However, Princess Yaoyin felt blocked just now, so she left the square with Shangguan Bingxin and wandered around the beast fighting area.
During this period, they heard a lot of movement in the central area. Out of curiosity, the two women came over to watch.
Unexpectedly, I met Gu Chenfeng again.
Seeing Gu Chenfeng suddenly looking towards them, Princess Yaoyin snorted and turned to leave.
"Wait!"
Gu Chenfeng's shout came from behind.
Princess Yaoyin didn't look back.
But Gu Chenfeng said: "Miss Shangguan, please stay."
"..."
Princess Yaoyin's steps froze.
Shangguan Bingxin's cool and beautiful face showed a hint of surprise.
"Mr. Gu, what's the matter?"
"Miss Shangguan, I would like to borrow some money."
"Borrow money?"
Shangguan Bingxin was stunned. Over the years, many men have asked her about her name, age, family background...
This was the first time someone came to her to borrow money.
So much so that she was a little unable to react.
"Miss Shangguan, do you have ten thousand taels of silver with you?"
"Not that much." Shangguan Bingxin replied subconsciously.
